user.title: Connect Librus Messages
user.description: Use your Synergia login for wiadomosci.librus.pl. No browser cookies are needed. Historical messages will not be announced.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Librus again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for this account. Message tracking will be preserved.

reconfigure.title: Update Librus password
reconfigure.description: Update the password for this account without resetting message tracking.

error.invalid_auth: Librus rejected the login or requires interactive verification. Check your Synergia credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch the messages inbox. Check connectivity and try again. The account must use the new messages application.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60.

tracking_reset.title: Librus message tracking was reset
tracking_reset.description: Saved message tracking was missing or corrupt. A fresh baseline was saved automatically. Messages already in the inbox at the reset were not announced. Future messages will generate events normally. No action is required.
